title: Random

fields.name: samples
fields.description: If set, it will only generate a specific number of samples.

fields.name: interval_sec
fields.description: Interval in seconds between samples generation.

fields.name: interval_nsec
fields.description: Specify a nanoseconds interval for samples generation, it works in conjunction with the Interval_Sec configuration key.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Random input plugin generate very simple random value samples using the device interface /dev/urandom, if not available it will use a unix timestamp as value.
